source: Synthetic DOM interactions, not recorded platform payloads: this plugin reads the page itself, so its fixtures are the markup it reads. Several carry data that must never be sent — a mailto address, a tel number, an access token in a query string, a form with a password field — so the stripping is exercised rather than assumed.

fixtures.name: clicks a link carrying an access token
fixtures.description: The query string holds a token. Only the host and path may be sent.

fixtures.name: clicks an email address
fixtures.description: The href IS the personal data. Only the fact of the click may be sent.

fixtures.name: clicks an internal link
fixtures.description: Already a RUM view; re-reporting it as an action would be noise.

payload.html: <form id="newsletter" data-lead aria-label="Newsletter signup" action="https://hooks.example.com/subscribe"><input name="email"><input type="password" name="password"></form>

fixtures.name: submits the newsletter form
fixtures.description: A form marked data-lead, so it also counts as a lead. No field value is ever read.

payload.html: <form id="newsletter" data-lead aria-label="Newsletter signup" action="https://hooks.example.com/subscribe"><input name="email" value="shopper@example.com"><input type="password" name="password" value="hunter2"></form>
<form id="search" aria-label="Site search" action="/search"><input name="q" value="red tee medium"></form>
